scope: Stage 2b of the 1st development plan: zero-point state selection on the classical manifold (D17) with the two criteria modes (D19), analytic tangent-space Hessian and classical refinement, and removal of the unconstrained 'quantum' optimizer (D18).

added.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/classical: tangent_frames, tangent_expansion (analytic gradient and Hessian in tangent coordinates, TangentExpansion), refine_classical (L-BFGS-B + Newton off the flat directions)
added.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/state_sel: select_on_manifold, SelectionCriteria, SelectionResult, verdict constants, rotation_matrix, rotate_state, fit_harmonics, rotation_symmetry, LSWTZeroPointEnergy / lswt_zero_point_energy (existing EnergyFunction through to_spin_system)
added.code-space/tests/test_methods/test_class: 5 tests: Hessian vs finite differences (3 cells), polar state, refinement

removed.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/optimizat: opt_method 'quantum'/'classical+quantum' branch, find_optimum_w_BFGS, find_optimum_w_BFGS_from_DE, QUANTUM_METHOD_NAME, QUANTUM_METHOD_WARNING; requesting 'quantum' now raises ValueError pointing to select_on_manifold; an unknown method raises ValueError instead of failing later
removed.code-space/tests/test_methods/test_optim: renamed to test_optimization.py; the 8 quantum tests replaced by the classical angle_setting=None test and 3 argument tests

tests.regression_snapshot: examples/package_regression_snapshot.py compare against the stage-1 baseline: 208 leaves, maximum difference 0.0

hessian.finite_difference_agreement: gradient <= 1.6e-10, Hessian <= 7.8e-10 (central differences, step 1e-4, O(step^2) error) for NBCP one/three/four MSL with SOC, NNN and DM terms at random states
hessian.y_v_after_refinement: Y (0.2 T) and V (1.4 T) with J_PD or J_Gamma = 0.010 from a start 1e-3 rad away: torque 1e-4 -> 1e-17, null eigenvalue ~1e-18 against the next 4.8e-3 (V) / 6.7e-3 (Y), axis error <= 1e-15 (finite-difference prototype: 1e-8)

nbcp_selection.summary: All 16 runs (Y, V x J_PD, J_Gamma x N = 6, 12 x two modes) are 'selected' about z with the reference harmonic (6; 3 for V with J_Gamma) and the expected number of equivalent minima.
nbcp_selection.regularization: MAGSWT shift stayed at its floor 1e-9 at every orbit point (no negative H(k) eigenvalue to compensate)

criteria_cases.summary: DE starts, three seeds, both modes: exact U(1) -> no_selection (6/6), J_PD, J_Gamma and J_PD rotated -> selected (18/18), polarized 20h -> no_degeneracy (6/6). Tilted field (0.3h, 0, h): physics 'competition' (C_cl / C_qm = 0.46), fixed 'no_degeneracy' (gap ratio 2e-2).

magswt_reproduction.summary: Start azimuth on the MAGSWT grid (0): same total energy within 4.7e-16 in all four cases. Start azimuth 0.3 rad (off the k pi/6 grid): the orbit search is lower by 1.3e-12 (Y, J_Gamma) to 8.1e-6 meV (V, J_PD).

findings_for_review: The tilted-field control is classically pinned (unique classical minimum) but its pinning curvature is comparable to the zero-point selection curvature; physics mode reports 'competition' and keeps both minima without choosing. Whether this should be reported as competition or as classical pinning is a physics decision.
D18 left MAGSWT to be re-decided after this reproduction check: the orbit search reproduces the grid result when the grid contains the minimum and finds lower energies otherwise.
